question: Infantile hypertrophic pyloric stenosis, false statement
question_ar: في تضيق البواب الضخامي عند الأطفال، يكون أحد الخيارات التالية خاطئًا؟ (سؤال مكرر، راجع السؤال رقم 544)

options.text: The infant usually presents with projectile non-bilious vomiting
The treatment is surgical by Ramstedt operation
Symptoms commence at age of 3-4 weeks
A palpable olive-shaped mass is usually felt in the epigastric region in the classical case
Usually, ultrasound is not sufficient for diagnosis

correct_text: Usually, ultrasound is not sufficient for diagnosis
